introduction: At the advanced level, examiners test acronym-heavy organizations like research councils (CSIR), food safety boards (FSSAI), and environmental tribunals (NGT).

core_concepts.title: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Trombay (Mumbai), Maharashtra**. 
Established: 1954 (Founded by Dr. Homi J. Bhabha). 
Key Fact: It is India's premier nuclear research facility.

core_concepts.title: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **New Delhi**. 
Established: 1942. 
Key Fact: It is the largest research and development (R&D) organization in India. The Prime Minister of India acts as its ex-officio President.

core_concepts.title: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **New Delhi**. 
Established: 2008 (Under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare). 
Key Fact: It is responsible for protecting and promoting public health through the regulation and supervision of food safety (the logo seen on all packaged food in India).

core_concepts.title: Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Mumbai (Wankhede Stadium)**. 
Established: 1928. 
Key Fact: It is the national governing body for cricket in India and the richest cricket board in the world.

core_concepts.title: National Green Tribunal (NGT)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **New Delhi**. 
Established: 2010. 
Key Fact: It is a specialized body equipped with the necessary expertise to handle environmental disputes involving multi-disciplinary issues.

important_entities.name: NASSCOM
important_entities.key_fact: The Voice of the IT Industry
important_entities.significance: Headquarters: **New Delhi/Noida**. The National Association of Software and Service Companies is the premier trade body and chamber of commerce of the Tech industry in India.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Students often assume the head of CSIR is a top scientist. Similar to NITI Aayog, the ex-officio President of CSIR is the **Prime Minister of India**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Bhabha built the Bomb in the Bay (Trombay)
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) is located in Trombay, a suburb of Mumbai.

exam_strategy_tips: A frequent question in UPSC and SSC CGL: 'Where is the principal bench of the National Green Tribunal (NGT) located?' Answer: New Delhi.
